description: Attach a file to a task in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key): a report, export, screenshot or spec the task is about. Send the file as base64 (at most 4 MB). The hosted remote server caps a whole request at 512 KB, so through it a file can be at most about 380 KB; for bigger files use the local server or the REST API upload (POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/attachments with fileName and size). Executables, scripts and HTML are refused. Files count against the file storage of the workspace plan; list_attachments shows the per-file limit and how much is used.

contentBase64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works)

name: upload_attachment
